0.0.11.en:
## What's New 🎉 

**All Platforms**
- Added an enable/disable toggle for installed keyboards. Disabled keyboards stay in the list but are hidden from hotkeys, the IME switcher, auto-activation, and tray/property menus.
- Keyboard cards now show secondary actions (View Layout, Disable, Remove) as compact 38×38 icon buttons with tooltips; Remove has a red danger hover.
- Keyboard layout viewer redesigned:
  - Pin and PDF buttons moved into the title bar as SVG icons under a unified ghost-button style.
  - New per-key label layout: ASCII top-left, shifted top-right, unshifted bottom-center.
  - Platform-aware modifier labels: CMD/OPT on macOS, SUPER on Linux, WIN/ALT on Windows.
  - New visual style — white window, light-gray chassis, softly-shadowed keys.
- External links (Website, GitHub) from the About page now open in the system browser. Previously broken on macOS where WKWebView silently ignored target="_blank" clicks.

**Linux**
- IBus layout/property menu now refreshes immediately when keyboards are enabled/disabled or installed/removed via the GUI — no need to deactivate and reactivate KeyMagic.
- Instructional code blocks (e.g. the IBus symbol customization commands) gained a one-click copy button.
